meaning:
πύρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(πυρόω), [in LXX: Pro.27:21 (כּוּר), Amo.4:9 (שְׁדֵפָה) * ;]
1. a burning: Rev.18:9, 18.
2. a refining or trial by fire: metaphorically, 1Pe.4:12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
